IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Friday, September 25, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is running hot. Sixty calls, 280 hands on the books, and Gurtz, Cupertino, and Pieper are all staffing the Port Washington Data Center. That's **$10/hr over scale** on the data center work — valid WI license required, but the money moves fast here. Book depth is tight enough that you're looking at quick dispatch.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** has 116 calls across 909 hands, which means book depth is real, but Miller Electrical and Inglett & Stubbs are hammering the QTS Fayetteville data center build-out at **$42/hr**. Work is steady; the line just moves slow. Tommy Jett's the general foreman on the Inglett & Stubbs calls if you want specifics.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** is small but surgical: only 9 calls, 156 hands, but O'Connell and Ferguson Electric are pulling bodies into the Lake Mariner Data Center at **$48.20/hr** with per diem incentives available. Ferguson's taking 15 a day max — first shift 6:30 AM–5:00 PM, orientation Tuesday only. Tight gate, fast work.

**LU-26 Washington, DC** has 56 calls across 333 hands on data center infrastructure around Manassas and Fredericksburg — JE Richards, Dynalectric, and Mid Atlantic all staffing. OSHA 30 is required on the Mid Atlantic multi-site call. No single rate posted across the board, but the volume is there.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is the dark horse: only 22 calls, 79 hands, but Veca's Micron job is **$45.33/hr** with **$170/day travel pay** if eligible, **+$20/hr travel premium**, running 4–10s on a 60/60/50 schedule. PLA/LARP job. That's real money if you're mobile.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** rounds out the board: Rosendin's Claude work sits at **$52.30/hr**, and Michels Power's lineman call in Midland hits **$60.59/hr** with **$175/day per diem**. Different crafts, but the premium is unmistakable.

Data centers are eating the board nationwide — every region's best volume and steadiest work is infrastructure build-out.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Friday, September 25, 2026**

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** is running hot—25 calls, 82 hands needed, and FAITH ELECTRIC LLC is posting **$49.8/hr** on Journeyman Lineman work in College Park/Columbus with **$150/day per diem**, hotels comp'd, and 4-10s. That's $3 over JL scale on distribution. PIERCE POWERLINE's statewide storm restoration crew hits **$46.8/hr** with **$100/day per diem**, 5-10s, but demands OH&UG experience. W2 ENERGY SERVICES is reconduct/conversion work at **$46.8/hr**, **$150/day per diem**, 8 on/6 off hitches mid-week starts. SERVICE ELECTRIC's substation tech call runs **$44.46/hr** across 11 slots statewide.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** — seven calls, 75 hands in the bucket, and data-center work is eating the board. Cache Valley Electric and Copperhead both posting **$48.25/hr** on Inside JW. Copperhead throws a wrench in it: night shift, **$10 over scale**, OT 1.5x weekdays / 2x weekends. Gephart's got six slots at **$48.25/hr** on 4/12s and 2/10s, double-time OT, OSHA10 gate. ArchKey Sachs is Google data center work West Memphis with day shift, 6am start, no posted rate on this one.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — nine calls, 53 hands. Parsons Electric dominates with 44 Inside JW slots on Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood at **$44.8/hr**, 6-10s, **$100/day non-taxed per diem** if you're 100+ miles out, plus **$100 incentive Mon-Fri** and **$150 Sat/Sun**. Non-taxed per diem moves the needle here.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** — 40 calls, 50 hands. Northern Powerline's JBER underground feeder rebuild pays **$76.9/hr** for three Journeyman Lineman slots with CDL Type A requirement. Fullford Inside JW work in Fairbanks sits at **$57.44/hr**. Alaska wage floor is real.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** — six calls, 34 hands. Veca Electric's Micron PLA job: 25 Inside JW at **$45.33/hr**, **$170/day per diem** x7 if eligible, 4-10s, plus **$20/hr travel pay**. PLA jobs lock you in but the money stacks.

Data-center buildouts and transmission projects are siphoning hands into the upper Midwest and Mountain West; scale-plus-per-diem combos are the move.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Friday, September 25, 2026**

**LU-208 Denver, CO** is the meat on the board right now—10 calls, 28 hands needed. US Eng. Metalworks is taking 10 fitters with SS fitting experience plus 3 SS TIG welders for shop work. IMD's got 5 welder slots (SS MIG, Industrial Scale) running 5/10's in the fab shop. Over in Fort Collins, US Eng. Construction is hunting 3 high-purity fitters who can bend tube on the Broadcom job. Trautman and Shreve split 3 combo welders across day and swing shifts (MIG/TIG). This is where the volume is.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** sits at 5 calls needing 41 hands—tighter board but serious depth. Gem's running two separate gigs: 16 combo welders (test required, benefits don't pyramid) at the fab shop, and 8 pipefitters for a 7-10 schedule at BDO. Graham's Cenovus maintenance call wants pipefitters current in DISA. Nooter's adding 5 more pipefitters on Cenovus fab work with a **$125/day** per diem incentive and DISA cert requirement. Lima's the play if you're willing to chase certifications.

**LU-213 St John, NB** is slim—2 calls, 12 hands—but doesn't sleep. CAM's running 10 journeyman pipefitters (GPMA Agreement, day shift) at Irving Oil Refinery. The unnamed contractor's got 2 welder slots at Irving Pulp and Paper in Lorneville, F3/F4 testing required, night shift. Refinery work in the Maritimes doesn't open up often.

Specialty certs (DISA, SS experience, high-purity tube work) are moving hands fast. Fab shops and refineries are hunting, and the Industrial Scale work in Denver's pulling West.
